recipes.title: Crepes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a blender until smooth.

Cook in an 8–9 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat, no cooking spray needed. Pour a thin layer of batter and swirl to coat the pan. Cook until edges begin to set, then flip and cook briefly on the other side.

recipes.title: German Pancakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Melt butter in a 9x9 pan in the hot oven.
Beat together eggs, milk, flour, and salt. Pour into the hot buttered pan.
Bake 18 minutes until puffed and golden brown.

recipes.title: Maple Syrup
instructions: Follow the directions on the Mapleine Maple Extract bottle to make homemade maple syrup.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pancakes with Buttermilk Syrup
instructions: For pancakes: Whisk together milk, pumpkin, oil, and eggs. Add flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt and stir until just combined. Cook on a greased griddle or skillet over medium heat.

For syrup: Combine butter, sugar, buttermilk, and corn syrup in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract and baking soda — it will foam up. Serve warm over pancakes.

recipes.title: Alfredo Sauce

items: Minced garlic or garlic salt, to taste

instructions: Over medium heat, bring cream and butter to a boil. Remove from heat, add Parmesan cheese, and stir until melted.
Season with salt, pepper, and garlic. Serve over 16 oz cooked pasta.

recipes.title: Baked Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Place chicken strips in a bowl and cover with milk; let soak 20–30 minutes.
Mix dry ingredients (salt, seasoned salt, pepper, flour, paprika) in a zip-lock bag. Cut butter into pieces and place in a 9x13 pan. Put pan in oven until butter is melted.
Shake excess milk off chicken and coat each piece with the dry mix. Place in pan with melted butter. Bake 40 minutes, turning halfway through.

recipes.title: Baked Ham Sandwiches
instructions: Place the bottoms of the rolls in a baking dish. Top with ham and cheese, cutting to size if necessary.

Melt butter and stir in Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, and poppy seeds. Brush the butter mixture over the sandwiches, using it all. Place tops on sandwiches and cover with foil. Chill several hours or overnight.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes, removing the foil for the last few minutes to brown the tops.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni & Cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 375°. Grease a 2-qt baking dish. Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain and rinse with cold water.
Melt ~1 Tbsp butter over low heat and mix in flour. Cook and stir about 1 minute, then gradually stir in milk. Add salt & pepper and bring to a simmer. Simmer 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add cheddar cubes and stir until partially melted. Remove from heat and stir in macaroni and Parmesan. Pour into baking dish. Top with buttered bread crumbs mixed with a little Parmesan.
Bake 25–30 minutes until crumbs are browned and mac is bubbly at edges.

recipes.title: Baked Parmesan Crusted Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Melt butter with garlic in a saucepan. Remove from heat and stir in bread crumbs, Parmesan, and herbs.
Dip each piece of chicken in the garlic butter, then press into the bread crumb mixture. Place in a greased 9x13 baking dish.
Bake 50 minutes until golden and cooked through.

recipes.title: Balsamic Chicken Sandwiches

items: 6 sub buns, ciabatta rolls, or 2 baguettes

instructions: Marinate chicken in balsamic vinaigrette overnight. Grill chicken until cooked through, then slice into thin strips.
If using baguettes, cut each into 3 pieces then slice open. Spread one side of each piece with 1 Tbsp pesto. Layer chicken, mozzarella, and tomato slices. Top with the other side of bread.
Serve immediately, or wrap in foil and heat 5–10 minutes in a 300° oven.

recipes.title: Beef Fajitas
instructions: In a skillet over medium-high heat, cook beef and onion in 2 Tbsp oil until meat is browned. Add bell peppers and cook several more minutes until crisp-tender.
Add tomatoes and taco seasoning combined with 1/4 c water. Cook just until water is gone. Serve on tortillas topped with sour cream, salsa, and cheese.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat 1 Tbsp oil in a large skillet and cook beef until no longer pink.

In a bowl, combine cream soup, sour cream, milk, and Worcestershire sauce; whisk until smooth. Add to the meat along with bouillon cubes. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until warm and bubbly and bouillon is dissolved.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve sauce over drained pasta.

recipes.title: Browned Butter with Mizithra Cheese Pasta
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions until tender. While pasta cooks, brown the butter in a saucepan over medium heat — it will foam then turn golden brown.
Drain pasta but do not rinse. Pour brown butter over pasta, sprinkle with mizithra cheese, and toss to coat. Garnish with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Risotto

items: 1 medium butternut squash, peeled and cubed

instructions: Heat the broth: Pour 6 cups broth into a medium pot over medium heat. Bring to a low simmer, then reduce heat and cover to keep warm.
Prep the squash: Peel, seed, and cut the butternut squash into 3/4-inch cubes.

Sauté the onion and squash: Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium-low. Cook onion until soft and golden, about 8 minutes. Add squash and stir to coat with oil. Cook about 10 minutes until beginning to soften. Season with salt, pepper, rosemary, and sage. Cook until just tender, about 4 more minutes. Scoop out half the squash pieces and set aside.

Add the rice: Stir in Arborio rice and toast it, stirring 3–5 minutes until pearly and translucent. Ladle in 3/4–1 cup of hot broth, stirring constantly until fully absorbed. Continue adding broth by the ladleful, stirring regularly, until rice is creamy and al dente (about 20 minutes total).
Finish: Stir in the reserved squash pieces. Add a final splash of broth for a flowing, wavy consistency. Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan and butter until fully melted. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Calzone

items: Dough for 1 loaf of bread (store-bought or homemade)
Meat of choice: pepperoni, sausage, ham, or ground beef

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Divide dough into 4 pieces. Roll each piece into a circle about 10 inches in diameter.
Fill each circle with meat, cheese, and spaghetti sauce. Fold in half and pinch edges closed. Place on a greased baking sheet.
Bake about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Heat cream cheese and milk over medium heat to a boil, stirring constantly. Stir in 1/2 c Parmesan. Reduce heat to low and cook 5 minutes.
Add chicken, peas, and pasta to the pot. Toss to combine, top with remaining Parmesan, and serve.
notes: For a more traditional sauce, substitute 2 Tbsp butter and 1 1/2 c heavy cream for the cream cheese and milk.

recipes.title: Chicken Burritos

items: 1/2 cup enchilada sauce or hot sauce (adjust to taste)

instructions: Sauté the diced pepper and onion in a large pan until just before they caramelize. Add the chicken and cook thoroughly.
Add cream cheese, enchilada sauce, corn, and beans. Stir until well combined and cream cheese is melted.
Fill tortillas with the chicken mixture and roll up. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas

items: 1 can black or kidney beans, drained

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 9x13 baking dish.
In a bowl, combine cream of chicken soup, sour cream, reserved chicken broth, and enough milk to make a creamy sauce. In another bowl, break chicken into pieces and stir in beans.

Divide the chicken-bean mixture among the 12 tortillas. Top each with 1/4 c cheese and 2 Tbsp sauce. Roll up and place side by side in the baking dish. Pour remaining sauce over the top, covering all tortillas. Top with remaining cheese.
Bake 20–30 minutes until heated through. Serve with chopped olives, salsa, and guacamole.

recipes.title: Chicken Pillows

items: Garlic salt, salt & pepper to taste

instructions: Combine chicken, cream cheese, chives, and seasonings; stir until just mixed.
Unroll crescent rolls, pressing 2 together to form rectangles. Place 1/4 of filling on each rectangle, fold over, and pinch edges to seal.
Dip each pillow in melted butter, then roll in bread crumbs. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve topped with prepared chicken gravy.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken

items: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut in half horizontally (see Tip) or 4 thin-sliced boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1 pint cherry or other small tomatoes, halved
½ small onion or 1 medium shallot, minced
1 teaspoon dried oregano (or 1 teaspoon chopped fresh oregano)
1 teaspoon dried basil (or 1 teaspoon chopped fresh basil), optional
½ cup grated Parmesan, plus more for serving
2 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature

instructions: Season both sides of the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
Heat a large pan over medium. Heat the olive oil in the pan. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown (but not cooked through), about 4 minutes on each side. Remove chicken from pan and set aside.

Add the butter to the pan and let it melt. Add tomatoes, onion, garlic and a pinch of salt, and cook, stirring, until the tomatoes and onion have just softened and the garlic is aromatic, 1 to 2 minutes.

Add broth, oregano and basil (if using), and stir to combine, scraping the browned bits from the bottom of the pan, and let simmer until the liquid has reduced by about half, 4 to 5 minutes. Add the heavy cream, grated Parmesan and cream cheese, and stir, allowing the cream cheese to soften and melt, until thickened, about 6 minutes. Add baby spinach and stir until the spinach begins to wilt, about 1 minute.
Return the chicken breasts to the pan and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, 4 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and serve immediately with more freshly grated Parmesan on top.
notes: To cut boneless, skinless chicken breasts in half horizontally, place them individually on a cutting board, leaving a few inches in between each. Place the palm of your hand on the chicken, apply pressure down, raise your fingers up and out of the way of your chef's knife, then slice breasts in half as evenly as possible, creating two thin cutlets.

recipes.title: Fish Tacos
instructions: Cook fish fillets according to package directions.
Mix together cabbage, sour cream, cilantro, lime juice, cumin, salt, and pepper to make the slaw.
Break or shred the cooked fish. Top each tortilla with fish, slaw, cheese, and salsa.

recipes.title: Ham Paninis
instructions: Heat a panini press or Foreman grill. For each sandwich, spread mayo on the inside of the bread, then layer ham, avocado, and cheese. Top with a second slice of bread and butter the outsides of both pieces.
Cook on the press or grill for 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted and outside is golden.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Haystack

ingredientGroups.heading: Base
items: 1 can chicken, or 2 chicken breasts cooked & shredded
1 can of milk (use empty soup can to measure)

instructions: Combine cream of chicken soup, milk, and chicken in a saucepan. Heat over medium heat until warm and bubbly.
Serve over rice with desired toppings.

recipes.title: Indian Butter Chicken

ingredientGroups.heading: Marinade
items: 1.5 lbs chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Combine marinade ingredients in a large zip-lock bag. Add chicken cubes and let chill for at least 1 hour.
Add the chicken along with the marinade to a large pot over medium-high heat. Cook about 5 minutes. Add butter and garlic and cook until butter is melted.
Add tomato sauce, cream, and spices. Stir to combine, then simmer 20–30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve with rice and naan bread.

recipes.title: Marinated Grilled Chicken (Xango Chicken)

items: 2–3 lbs boneless skinless chicken tenders (thighs taste best)
1 tsp ground ginger (or shredded fresh ginger)

instructions: Mix all ingredients together and let chicken marinate for up to 24 hours.
Grill on an indoor or outdoor grill until no longer pink. Serves 4–6.

recipes.title: One-Pan Dumplings With Greens

items: 2 tablespoons avocado or other neutral oil
1 pound frozen, unthawed dumplings, any flavor
1 bunch kale, thick stems cut off, leaves (with ribs) coarsely chopped
1 tablespoon low-sodium soy sauce, plus more for serving
1 tablespoon unseasoned rice vinegar, plus more for serving
Toasted sesame seeds, cilantro, sliced scallions or chile crisp, or a combination (all optional), for serving

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add the dumplings flat sides down and cook until golden brown underneath, 1 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet, still over medium-high, and stir to coat in the oil, then add the kale and a pinch of salt. Stir until wilted. Add the dumplings on top of the kale and partially cover the skillet with a lid or baking sheet. Pour ¼ cup water into the skillet, cover completely, and steam until the dumplings are tender and cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes.
Drizzle with the soy sauce and rice vinegar, then serve with more of both, plus sesame seeds and chile crisp, as you like.

recipes.title: Orange Chicken
instructions: Bake chicken tenders according to package directions.
Combine all sauce ingredients in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sauce is thick and bubbly.
Serve chicken and sauce over rice.

recipes.title: Philly Cheesesteak Sloppy Joe's
instructions: In a large cast iron skillet, flatten ground beef and cook over medium heat without stirring until the bottom is brown and crispy. Flip and continue cooking, breaking up the meat, until no pink remains. Remove meat from pan.
In the meat drippings, cook the onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms a few minutes until soft. Dissolve cornstarch in broth, then add ketchup, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper.

Return meat to pan and add the broth mixture. Simmer over low heat 5 minutes or until little liquid remains. Top toasted buns with meat and a slice of provolone. Broil briefly to melt cheese if desired.

recipes.title: Queso Mac & Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Dice the bell peppers and onion, spread on a greased baking sheet, and roast 30–40 minutes.
Combine roasted vegetables with chicken, enchilada sauce, green chiles, fire-roasted tomatoes, garlic, onion powder, salt, pepper, and cayenne in a slow cooker. Cook on low 3–4 hours.
Cook shell pasta for half the time shown on the box. Blend together the queso sauce ingredients (cottage cheese, cream cheese, cheddar, enchilada sauce, milk) until smooth.
Add the par-cooked pasta and blended queso sauce to the slow cooker with the chicken and vegetables. Cook on high 15–20 minutes until pasta is tender.

recipes.title: Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook onions and ham in butter until softened.
Spread grated cheese in the pastry shell. Add flour, ham, and onions and stir slightly. Pour beaten eggs over the mixture.
Bake 40 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Apple Brickle Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese, sugars, and vanilla until smooth. Fold in toffee brickle chips.
Serve with apple slices. Refrigerate any leftovers.

recipes.title: Frog-Eye Salad

items: 8 oz acini de pepe pasta, cooked and drained
1 (10 oz) can pineapple tidbits, drained (reserve 1/4 c juice)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the reserved pineapple juice, milk, sugar, and pudding mix for 2 minutes.
Gently fold in pasta, pineapple tidbits, crushed pineapple, mandarin oranges, marshmallows, coconut, and Cool Whip. Cover and chill several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all fruit in a large bowl. Add vanilla yogurt and gently toss to coat. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add rice and onion. Sauté, stirring constantly, until rice begins to brown.
Add water, tomato sauce, chicken bouillon, and garlic salt. Stir until blended and bring to a boil. Lay cilantro stems on top and reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until all water is absorbed and rice is tender. Remove cooked cilantro and serve.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad

ingredientGroups.heading: Salad
items: 4–5 strips bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled

instructions: Combine spinach, celery, bacon, eggs, and mandarin oranges in a large bowl.
Whisk together all dressing ingredients. Toss with salad just before serving.

recipes.title: Turkish Flatbread (Naan Bread)
instructions: Combine yeast, sugar, and warm water in a large bowl and stir well. Allow to sit 5–10 minutes until foamy. Whisk in the Greek yogurt, olive oil, and salt. Add flour and stir until dough comes together. Knead 3–4 minutes. Divide into 20 equal pieces and cover with a kitchen towel. Rest 15 minutes.

Preheat a skillet to medium-low. Roll each piece into a 7-inch circle. Lightly brush the top with olive oil, then place oiled side down on the hot pan. Brush the top with oil. Cook 1–2 minutes until the surface is covered with bubbles and the underside is golden.
Flip and cook until the other side has golden brown spots. Place on a kitchen-towel-covered plate, sprinkle with parsley, and cover to keep moist.

recipes.title: French Silk Pie

items: 3 oz unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
Whipped cream and chocolate curls to garnish (optional)

instructions: Beat sugar and butter with an electric mixer on medium speed about 4 minutes until fluffy. Stir in melted chocolate and vanilla.
Add eggs one at a time, beating on high speed after each addition and scraping sides of bowl constantly.
Transfer to baked pastry shell. Cover and chill 5–24 hours until set. Top with whipped cream and chocolate curls before serving.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Pie

items: 8 large fresh peaches, peeled and sliced

instructions: In a small saucepan, mix sugar, water, and cornstarch until dissolved. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils and thickens. Remove from heat and cool completely — glaze will thicken more as it cools.
Place peeled, sliced peaches in a large bowl. Pour half the glaze over the fruit and gently mix to coat. Add more glaze as needed.
Pour glazed peaches into the pie crust, piling as high as desired. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Serve cold with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Ginger Snaps
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add egg and molasses and mix well. Stir in dry ingredients (flour, ginger, cinnamon, salt, baking soda).
Form into small balls and roll in sugar. Place on baking sheet and bake 10 minutes. Cool on a rack.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: Melt butter and baking chocolate together in a saucepan. Add evaporated milk, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract.
Boil, stirring constantly, for 6 minutes or until sauce begins to thicken. Serve warm over ice cream.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix melted butter with sugar, vanilla, and salt. Add flour and blend — dough will be thick like cookie dough. Press into the bottom of a 9x9 glass baking pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until edges begin to brown.

Whisk eggs, sugar, and flour until thick and light yellow. Slowly add lemon juice, whisking as you pour. Pour lemon filling over hot crust and return to oven. Bake about 25 minutes until completely set.
Remove from oven and cool completely. Refrigerate at least 2 hours until chilled. Dust with powdered sugar before serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine butter and peanut butter in a saucepan. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until melted. Add vanilla and powdered sugar and stir to combine.

Spread into a buttered 8x8 pan lined with parchment paper. Fold excess parchment over the surface and refrigerate until firm. Cut into 1-inch pieces. Store at room temperature in an airtight container up to 1 week.

recipes.title: Pretzel Jello Salad
instructions: Mix crushed pretzels, melted butter, and sugar. Press into the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish. Bake at 350° for 8–10 minutes. Let cool.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, and Cool Whip until smooth. Spread over the cooled crust, making sure to cover all the pretzels and seal the edges completely.
Dissolve Jello in 2 c boiling water. Stir in frozen strawberries until combined. Pour over the cream cheese layer and chill until completely set.

recipes.title: Shannon's Raspberry Cake

items: 1 white cake mix (plus ingredients as directed)

instructions: Bake white cake on a sheet cake pan for 20 minutes. Cool completely.

Thaw raspberries and drain juice. Add enough water to the juice to equal 1 1/3 cups total liquid. Combine with raspberry Danish Dessert and microwave, stirring until thick (3–5 minutes). Stir in raspberries and let cool.
Beat powdered sugar with softened cream cheese until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip.
Spread cream cheese mixture over cooled cake. Spread raspberry topping over the cream cheese layer. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Pesto
instructions: Combine basil, Parmesan, and garlic in a food processor and pulse until puréed.
With the processor running, add olive oil slowly until well combined. Freeze leftovers in an ice cube tray for easy portioning.

recipes.title: Cafe Rio Cilantro Lime Ranch

items: Buttermilk and mayonnaise (as directed on package)

instructions: Prepare ranch dressing according to package directions. Add cilantro, Tabasco, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Blend or process until smooth and cilantro is fully incorporated. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Garam Masala
instructions: Mix all spices together in a small bowl. Transfer to an airtight container and store in a cool, dry place.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Rosa Chicken Pasta
instructions: Boil Pasta: Cook pasta in salted water. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
Sear Chicken: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Season chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and half the Italian seasoning. Sauté until cooked through; remove and set aside.
Sauté Veggies: In the same skillet, cook stir-fry vegetables until tender-crisp.
Simmer Sauce: Lower heat. Add tomato sauce, cream cheese, honey, and remaining Italian seasoning. Stir until cream cheese is fully melted and sauce is pink.
Combine: Fold in the cooked pasta and chicken. Add reserved pasta water in small splashes until the sauce is glossy and coats everything evenly.
Finish: Stir in Parmesan cheese. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Topgolf Queso French Fries

ingredientGroups.heading: Queso
items: 6 oz Monterey Jack cheese, block -- shred yourself for best melt
4 oz Pepper Jack cheese, block -- shred yourself
1/4 cup milk (add more to thin if needed)
1 can (10 oz) Rotel diced tomatoes & green chiles, drained

ingredientGroups.heading: Toppings
items: Bacon bits or cooked, crumbled bacon strips

instructions: Bake the fries. Cook crinkle cut fries according to package directions (typically 425°F for 25-30 min). Season with salt right when they come out.
Sauté the onion. Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Reduce heat to medium-low.
Melt in the cheese. Add cream cheese first and stir until melted. Then add the Monterey Jack and Pepper Jack in handfuls, stirring constantly until smooth. Add milk to loosen if needed.
Finish the queso. Stir in the drained Rotel and garlic powder. Season with salt. Keep warm on low heat, stirring occasionally.
Assemble. Pile fries onto a plate or oven-safe dish. Pour queso generously over the top. Add bacon, jalapeños, green onions, and a dollop of sour cream.
Serve immediately while fries are hot and crispy.
notes: Shred cheese yourself from blocks -- pre-shredded cheese contains anti-caking agents that prevent it from melting smoothly.
To keep the queso warm for serving, transfer to a small slow cooker on the "warm" setting.

recipes.title: Chickpea Salad

ingredientGroups.heading: Dressing
items: 2 tablespoons minced fresh dill, plus more for serving
2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley, plus more for serving

ingredientGroups.heading: Salad
items: 1/2 cup thinly sliced scallions, white and green parts (2 to 3 scallions)

instructions: In a small bowl, combine the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, salt and pepper. Whisk until smooth, then add the dill and parsley and stir to combine. Set aside.
Place the chickpeas in a large bowl and using a fork, lightly mash about 1/3 of them. Add the celery and scallions and toss.

Pour the dressing over the salad, toss well, and set aside at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before serving. Sprinkle with more dill and parsley and serve. (If you're not serving the dish immediately, you can store it in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. Let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving.)

recipes.title: Lemon-Lime Delight Bars

ingredientGroups.heading: Filling
items: 2 Tbsp. fresh lime juice & zest to taste

instructions: Combine butter, powdered sugar, and flour, mixing well. Press into 9×13 baking pan and bake 15 minutes at 350 degrees.
Blend eggs, sugar, flour, juices, and zest together; pour into slightly cooled crust. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until set.
Chill and sprinkle with additional powdered sugar if desired.
notes: Throw a few of these bars into a blender with some vanilla ice cream. You'll have a refreshing shake with cookie bits!

recipes.title: Oatmeal with Toppings

items: 1 cup milk (or water if milk is unavailable)

instructions: Pour 1 cup of milk (or water) into a pot and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Stir in 1/2 cup quick oats and a pinch of salt. Reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oats reach your desired consistency (add more milk if you prefer thinner oatmeal, or simmer longer for thicker).
Transfer to a bowl.
Top with your choice of brown sugar, butter, cinnamon, fresh or frozen berries, nuts, peanut butter, honey, or jam.
Serve warm. Let it cool slightly if needed before eating.
notes: Quick, customizable, and great for using pantry staples. Can scale up easily for multiple servings.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tacos

items: 1 (15 oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed
1/2 cup shredded cheese (cheddar, Mexican blend, or cotija)
1/2 cup diced tomatoes (fresh or canned, drained)
Optional: 1/2 teaspoon cumin or 1/4 teaspoon chili powder

instructions: Drain and rinse 1 can of black beans in a colander.
Heat the beans in a saucepan over medium heat for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until warmed through.
Season the warm beans with salt, pepper, and optional cumin or chili powder to taste (about 1/2 tsp cumin or 1/4 tsp chili powder total).

Warm tortillas using one of these methods: directly over a gas flame for 10-15 seconds per side until lightly charred, in a dry skillet over medium heat for 20-30 seconds per side until soft and warm, or wrapped in a damp paper towel and microwaved for 30 seconds.
Place approximately 1/4 cup warm beans in the center of each tortilla.
Add toppings: diced tomatoes, 2 tbsp salsa, cheese, sliced avocado, or any other preferred toppings.
Fold tortillas and serve immediately.
notes: Budget-friendly, quick, and very flexible with toppings.
Extra beans can be refrigerated for 4 days or frozen for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Rice & Beans with Vegetables

items: 2 cups cooked rice (white, brown, or jasmine)
1 (15 oz) can beans (black, pinto, or kidney beans), drained and rinsed
1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes, with juice
Optional: 1/4 teaspoon chili powder or red pepper flakes for heat

instructions: If rice is not already cooked, prepare 2 cups of cooked rice according to package directions.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 3 minced garlic cloves and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add drained and rinsed beans (1 can) and corn (1 cup). Stir and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the diced tomatoes with their juice and stir to combine.
Add 1 teaspoon ground cumin and stir well.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Add optional chili powder or red pepper flakes if desired.
Serve over 1/2 cup cooked rice per serving.
notes: Budget-friendly, flexible with vegetables and bean types.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 3 months. Works well as a meal prep.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice

items: 1/2 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, diced into 1/2 inch pieces
2 tablespoons oil (peanut, sesame, vegetable, or canola)
1 cup frozen peas and diced carrots blend
3 cups cooked white long grain rice

instructions: Heat a large non-stick wok or skillet to medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken and 2 tbsp oil; sauté for 4-5 minutes until cooked through. Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the frozen peas and carrots blend, and chopped onion. Sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for 1 more minute.
Push the vegetables to one side of the skillet and pour the 2 lightly beaten eggs on the other side; scramble them together with the vegetables.
Return the cooked chicken to the skillet along with 3 cups cooked rice and 3-4 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce. Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasonings (salt, pepper) as needed. Add 1-2 tbsp sriracha for spice if desired.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with green onions.
notes: Source: Gimme Delicious (https://gimmedelicious.com/chicken-fried-rice/)
Excellent for using leftover rice.
Keeps in an airtight container for up to 4 days in the refrigerator or freezes for up to 4 months.

recipes.title: Chili-Lime Chicken Bowls

items: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs (4 small pieces)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together all marinade ingredients (lime juice, lime zest, minced garlic, cilantro, 4 tbsp oil, brown sugar, chili powder, cumin powder, salt, and black pepper).
Add 1 pound chicken (breasts or thighs) to the marinade bowl and mix until fully coated. Marinate for at least 20 minutes (or up to 8 hours for more flavor).
Heat a grill or skillet to medium-high heat. Cook marinated chicken for 5-8 minutes per side until cooked through. Let cool 5 minutes, then slice.
Place 2 cups sliced bell peppers in the same pan and cook for 3-4 minutes until charred.
Allow everything to cool to room temperature.
Distribute 1 cup cooked rice into each of 4 meal-prep containers, then divide sliced chicken and peppers equally among them.
Seal containers and refrigerate for up to 4 days.
notes: Source: Gimme Delicious (https://gimmedelicious.com/chili-lime-chicken-and-rice-meal-prep-bowls/)
Excellent for meal prep, stays fresh 4 days refrigerated.
Can customize with toppings like avocado, sour cream, or black beans.
Family favorite — rated 5/5.

recipes.title: Creamy Coconut Curry Lentils with Spinach
instructions: Mince garlic and ginger; dice onion.
Sauté minced garlic and grated ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced onion and continue sautéing over medium heat until soft and translucent (about 3-5 minutes).
Add 1 tablespoon curry powder and sauté for 1 minute more to toast the spices.
Add 1 cup dry brown lentils and 2 cups vegetable broth to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Cover the skillet, increase heat to medium-high, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
After lentils are tender, add 1 (13 oz) can coconut milk and stir to combine.
Increase heat to medium and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring frequently to thicken the mixture.
Turn heat off and add 3 cups fresh baby spinach, stirring gently until wilted.
Taste and adjust seasoning (salt and curry powder) as needed.
Serve over rice and top with chopped cilantro if desired.
notes: Source: Budget Bytes (https://www.budgetbytes.com/creamy-coconut-curry-lentils-with-spinach/)
Creamy, plant-based, budget-friendly, excellent for meal prep.
Stays fresh in the refrigerator for 4-5 days.
Rated 2/5 — didn't love it.

recipes.title: Garbanzo Bean Curry

items: 1 (15 oz) can garbanzo beans (chickpeas), drained and rinsed
1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes, with juice
2 cups cooked rice (white, brown, or jasmine)
Optional: 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes, chopped cilantro for serving

instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet or pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion (about 1 medium onion) and cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and slightly translucent.
Add 3 minced garlic cloves and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 2 tablespoons curry powder and 1 teaspoon ground cumin. Stir constantly for about 1 minute to toast the spices and release their flavors.
Add drained and rinsed garbanzo beans (1 can) and stir to coat with the curry mixture.
Pour in the diced tomatoes with their juice and stir to combine well.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Taste and add additional curry powder or cumin if desired. Add red pepper flakes for heat if desired.
If rice is not already cooked, prepare 2 cups of cooked rice according to package directions while the curry simmers.
Serve curry over approximately 1/2 cup cooked rice per serving in individual bowls. Top with chopped cilantro if desired.
notes: Hearty, flavorful, and vegetarian.
Can add 1/2 cup coconut milk in the last 5 minutes for a creamier version, or add 1 cup frozen vegetables along with the beans.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans

ingredientGroups.heading: For the Potatoes
items: 1½ lbs mini potatoes, sliced in half or quarters
A few turns freshly ground black pepper

ingredientGroups.heading: For the Beans
items: 1 lb green beans, trimmed and cut in half

ingredientGroups.heading: For Garnish (optional)
items: ⅓ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss potato pieces with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, ½ tsp kosher salt, and black pepper to taste. Spread evenly on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast potatoes for 20 minutes.
While potatoes are roasting, combine trimmed and halved green beans with 1 tbsp olive oil, ½ tsp garlic powder, and ¼ tsp kosher salt in the same bowl used for potatoes.
After the initial 20 minutes, remove the baking sheet, stir the potatoes, then add the green beans in an even layer around them.
Roast for another 25 minutes until potatoes are tender inside and beans are fork-tender (total roasting time: 45 minutes).
Sprinkle with ⅓ cup grated parmesan cheese and chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Serve immediately. Store leftovers in a sealed container for up to 4 days.
notes: Source: The Recipe Well (https://therecipewell.com/roasted-potatoes-and-green-beans/)
Simple, budget-friendly side dish. Can be eaten warm as a side or standalone light meal.

recipes.title: Omelets with Ham, Cheese & Veggies

items: 1/4 cup shredded cheese (cheddar, Mexican blend, or mozzarella)

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add diced ham (1/4 cup), halved cherry tomatoes (1/4 cup), and sliced green onions (2 stems). Sauté for 1-2 minutes until vegetables are slightly softened. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
In a small bowl, beat 2 large eggs together with 1 tablespoon milk (or water), salt, and pepper until well combined.
Pour beaten eggs into the skillet (no need to add more oil if there's enough residual oil). Immediately return the ham and vegetable mixture to the skillet, distributing it evenly over the eggs.
Let the eggs cook undisturbed for about 1 minute until the bottom is set and starting to brown slightly.
Gently push cooked portions toward the center of the pan and tilt the skillet so uncooked egg flows to the edges. Continue cooking for another 30 seconds to 1 minute.
When the top is still slightly wet but mostly set (about 1-2 minutes total cooking), sprinkle 1/4 cup shredded cheese on one half of the omelet.
Arrange sliced avocado (1/4 avocado) on top of the cheese.
Using a spatula, gently fold the omelet in half so the cheese and avocado are enclosed, then slide onto a plate.
Serve immediately while warm.
notes: Protein-rich, perfect for breakfast or dinner.
Fillings can be easily customized with other vegetables, meats, or cheeses based on available ingredients.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Conchiglie Pasta

items: 1 cup whipping cream (or omit for lighter version)

instructions: Sauté chopped onion in a large pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until translucent.
Add chopped carrots to the pan and continue sautéing for another 5-7 minutes until the onions are soft and carrots begin to soften.
Add the can of diced tomatoes (with juices) to the pan and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened slightly and the carrots are tender.
Season with salt to taste.
While the sauce simmers, cook the conchiglie pasta according to package directions (typically 8-10 minutes). Drain pasta and set aside.
If using whipping cream, stir it into the tomato sauce in the last 2 minutes of simmering. Stir well to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the tomato mixture and stir gently to coat all shells evenly.
Transfer to serving bowls or meal-prep containers and sprinkle generously with parmesan cheese.
Serve warm. Store leftovers in sealed containers in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.
notes: Comfort food classic. Excellent for meal prep.
Can be made lighter by omitting cream. Carrots add natural sweetness and nutrition.

recipes.title: One-Pot French Onion Pasta

items: 12 oz mezze rigatoni or other short pasta

instructions: Melt butter with olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.

Add sliced onions and sauté frequently, stirring often, for about 1 hour until they reach a deep golden brown color and become jammy. This is the key step—patience is essential for developing the rich onion flavor.
Once caramelized, add minced garlic and fresh thyme, cooking for about 3-4 minutes until very fragrant.
Pour in white wine and deglaze the pot by scraping up the browned bits from the bottom with a wooden spoon.
Add Worcestershire sauce, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Add beef broth, water, and uncooked pasta directly to the pot. Stir to combine.

Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer while stirring frequently for about 8-10 minutes, until the pasta is al dente and a good amount of liquid has evaporated (the mixture should be saucy but not soupy).
Remove from heat and stir in heavy cream and grated Gruyère cheese until fully incorporated and creamy.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. Serve immediately.
notes: Source: Cozy Cravings (https://cozycravings.com/one-pot-french-onion-pasta/)
Cozy, one-pot meal inspired by French onion soup. The long caramelization time is crucial for developing depth of flavor.
For best results, use a good quality Gruyère cheese.

recipes.title: Cheesy Garlic Chicken Wraps

items: 1/4 cup sour cream or Greek yogurt
1.5 cups shredded cheddar or Mexican blend cheese
Hot sauce, optional (1-2 tbsp if desired)

instructions: Slice or dice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, sour cream (or yogurt), minced garlic, and hot sauce if using. Mix until smooth and creamy.

Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken pieces and cook for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through. Let cool slightly, then roughly chop the cooked chicken.
Place a tortilla flat on a work surface.
Spread about 2 tbsp of the mayo-garlic mixture down the center of the tortilla.
Layer with cooked chicken (about 1/4 of the total), then sprinkle with shredded cheese (about 1/3 cup) and sliced green onions.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla and roll tightly from one end to create a burrito-style wrap.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in the same skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and pan-fry for 3-4 minutes per side until golden, crispy, and the cheese melts.
Serve immediately while the cheese is warm and melted.
notes: Source: Cooked and Loved (https://www.cookedandloved.com/recipes/cheesy-garlic-chicken-wraps/)
Can be assembled ahead and refrigerated, then cooked fresh before serving for best texture.
For a lighter version, use air fryer at 375°F for 6-8 minutes instead of pan-frying.

recipes.title: Chicken and Broccoli Pasta with White Sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente according to package directions (typically 8-10 minutes). Reserve 1 cup of pasta cooking water, then drain pasta and set aside.
In the same pot of boiling water (or a separate pot), add broccoli florets and steam for 8-10 minutes until tender-crisp. Drain and set aside.
Pat the chicken breast dry with paper towels and season both sides with salt and pepper.

Heat 2 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Once hot, add chicken breast and sear for 8-10 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature should reach 165°F). Remove chicken to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes, then slice into bite-sized pieces.
In the same skillet, heat remaining 1 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn.
Sprinkle flour over the garlic and oil, stirring constantly for about 1-2 minutes until the raw flour smell disappears and it forms a light paste (roux).
Slowly pour in milk and cream, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Continue stirring as the sauce heats and thickens, about 3-5 minutes.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Add cooked pasta and broccoli to the sauce, stirring gently to coat everything evenly. If the sauce is too thick, add a splash of reserved pasta water to reach desired consistency.
Add sliced chicken back to the pan and gently toss to combine.
Serve immediately, optionally drizzling with a bit of extra virgin olive oil.
notes: Source: Flavor Quotient (https://flavorquotient.com/2016/11/broccoli-and-chicken-pasta-with-white-sauce/)
Quick, creamy, and satisfying pasta dish with good protein from the chicken.
The key to a smooth sauce is tempering the milk gradually and stirring constantly.
For a lighter version, reduce the cream to 1/4 cup and increase milk to 2 cups.

recipes.title: Baked Hasselback Potatoes

items: 5-6 medium potatoes (Russet or Yukon Gold, about 8 oz each)
1.5 tsp extra virgin olive oil (for initial rub)
1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil (for basting)
4 garlic cloves, skin on, smashed, optional but recommended
3 sprigs fresh rosemary, optional but recommended

instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C/400°F (180°C fan).
Scrub and rinse potatoes thoroughly under running water. Pat dry completely with paper towels.

Place a potato on a cutting board between two wooden spatulas, chopsticks, or wooden skewers that are no thicker than 1cm. These will prevent you from cutting all the way through the potato. Using a sharp knife, slice thinly across the potato (aim for about 2mm slices) perpendicular to the chopsticks, slicing approximately 90% of the way through but not all the way to the bottom. This creates thin "pages" within the potato that will fan out as it cooks.
Repeat slicing for all potatoes.
Rub each sliced potato with 1.5 tsp olive oil and sprinkle with 1/4 tsp salt, rubbing the oil and salt into the slices.
Place potatoes on a roasting tray lined with foil or parchment paper.
Bake at 200°C/400°F for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven. Pour 1/4 cup olive oil over the potatoes and sprinkle with 1.25 tsp salt. Scatter smashed garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs around and between the potatoes.
Return to oven and bake for another 40 minutes, basting generously with the oil from the tray every 10 minutes. The oil helps the slices get crispy and cook evenly.
After 40 minutes, check that the potatoes are tender inside by piercing with a fork.
Once soft, increase oven temperature to 220°C/425°F (200°C fan). Baste again and bake for another 10-15 minutes until the edges and top are golden and crispy.
Remove from oven and serve immediately while hot and crispy. Discard garlic skins if desired.
notes: Source: RecipeTin Eats (https://www.recipetineats.com/hasselback-potatoes/)
The key to perfect hasselback potatoes is frequent basting—this creates the crispy exterior while keeping the inside tender.
The thin slicing is essential for creating that beautiful fanned effect. Don't skip the garlic and rosemary; they add wonderful flavor.
Excellent as a side dish or light main course.

recipes.title: Ube Biko with Custard Topping
instructions: Grease an 8x8-inch square pan generously with oil.

In a large pot over medium heat, combine coconut milk and water with the glutinous rice. Simmer, then reduce heat to low and cover. Cook until the liquids are absorbed—the rice should be almost cooked at this stage.

While the rice cooks, prepare the ube halaya by combining ube, coconut milk, and evaporated milk in a large pan over medium heat until fork tender. Mash into a puree using an immersion blender or potato masher.
Add the condensed milk and stir constantly until thick and smooth.
Fold the half-cooked rice into the ube halaya mixture until combined. Transfer to the greased pan and spread evenly.
Mix all custard ingredients in a bowl and pour over the rice mixture. Bake at 180°C (356°F) for 15–25 minutes until the custard is golden and cooked through.
notes: Source: Foxy Folksy (https://www.foxyfolksy.com/ube-biko/)
The rice should remain slightly undercooked before baking; avoid overstirring while cooking to prevent mushiness.
Ready-made ube halaya can be substituted for the homemade version.
No-bake alternative: cook the custard on the stovetop in a skillet covered with banana leaves for 15–20 minutes.
Store in an airtight container for 2–3 days; reheat in the microwave.

recipes.title: Honey Pecan Granola
instructions: Heat oven to 300°F. Line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment.
In a large bowl, stir together oats, pecans, chia seeds, brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt.
In a smaller bowl, whisk the melted coconut oil, honey, maple syrup, and vanilla until smooth.
Pour the wet over the dry and stir until every oat is coated — 30 seconds longer than feels necessary. Dry patches are what turn into loose, dusty granola.
Spread on the sheet pan and press flat with the back of a spatula. Pressing is what makes clusters.

Bake 40–45 minutes, rotating the pan once at 20 minutes. Don't stir if you want big clusters; stir every 15 minutes if you'd rather have loose granola. It will still look slightly soft when done — it crisps as it cools.
Cool completely on the pan, undisturbed, about an hour. Then break into clusters.
notes: Makes about 6 cups (12 servings of 1/2 cup). Prep 10 minutes, bake 45 minutes, cool 1 hour.
Store airtight at room temperature for 2–3 weeks, or freeze up to 3 months. The pecans set the limit — their oils go rancid before the granola goes stale.
